rows.text: acme-platform uses pnpm 9 (pinned pnpm@9.12.0) since the September 2026 migration off yarn 1; npm and yarn must not be used. They write their own lockfiles (package-lock.json / yarn.lock) and CI rejects the PR. The only-allow pnpm preinstall guard does not catch `yarn add`.

An untracked yarn.lock keeps reappearing in acme-platform (written locally 2026-09-29); something runs `yarn` in the repo, probably a VS Code extension or shell alias. Jordan said he would check his VS Code extensions; do not commit it. yarn.lock was deleted in 3c81d0e.

acme-platform contributing conventions: run `nvm use` (reads .nvmrc); copy .env.example to .env.local and fill secrets from 1Password; branch names start with the Linear id, e.g. acme-412-retry-webhooks.
Git hooks in acme-platform run through lefthook (lefthook.yml at repo root); husky was removed on 2026-09-29. Jordan wants any leftover .husky references removed.

The acme-platform API reads its database connection only from DATABASE_URL (commit 9e04b7a dropped the PG* fallbacks) and fails fast at boot if it is missing. apps/api/.env.local needs a DATABASE_URL line copied from .env.example; Jordan's local db connection broke on 2026-09-30 because his .env.local lacked it.

Primary keys for any new table in acme-platform must be UUID v7, generated app-side with uuidv7() via $defaultFn in drizzle; not serial and not UUID v4. New tables also follow the convention of org_id, created_at and deleted_at columns and an index on org_id. Migrations are generated with `pnpm --filter api db:generate` into apps/api/drizzle/ (latest: 0031_brisk_payment_reminders).

Worker shutdown in acme-platform: on SIGTERM the worker stops taking jobs and drains in-flight ones with a 30s grace period (GRACE_PERIOD_MS in services/worker/src/shutdown.ts), matched by terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 30 in infra/helm/worker/values.yaml. Pods get killed mid-job during deploys: image-resize jobs can exceed 30s and w.close() can still pick up one more job. Priya says it is on our side; proposed fix (not yet made): pause workers before close and raise both values together (e.g. 90s app, 100s Helm).

Invoice PDF downloads are named invoice-<number>-<client-slug>.pdf (e.g. invoice-0042-smith-jones.pdf) using slugify in apps/api/src/lib/slug.ts; the clients list search (GET /v1/clients?q=) is debounced 300ms on the web side.

Jordan asked for a notification-preferences settings page shell (heading + empty form) in the dashboard but deferred it ('later'); the assistant was unsure of the web app's routing setup and should inspect apps/web and match existing settings screens.

Terraform state for acme-platform lives in S3 bucket acme-tfstate (key platform/prod.tfstate, us-east-1, encrypted) with DynamoDB lock table acme-tfstate-lock, configured in infra/terraform/backend.tf. A committed backend_override.tf (b27f9aa) forced a local backend and made CI plans show 47 resources to add; removed on branch acme-438-remove-tf-local-backend (commit 5e0a1c4), not pushed and no PR yet. Anyone who ran terraform init with the override must run `terraform init -reconfigure`.

infra/ and .github/ in acme-platform are platform-owned: infra changes need a platform-team reviewer (Priya) and the plan output pasted in the PR description (for the Terraform backend fix, a plan showing 0 to add).
Jordan's side project is trailmix, a Django app with HTMX partials and Hike/Photo models; he sometimes asks Django ORM questions in work sessions.
Code style in acme-platform TypeScript: 2-space indentation, single quotes, semicolons, imports with external packages first then local.

Lena owns the apps/web/messages files (e.g. en.json) and is mid-refactor on them as of 2026-10-02; do not edit them. Jordan reverted a 'recieve' typo fix in en.json (paymentPending string) for this reason and may mention the typo to Lena.

`pnpm --filter api db:seed` seeds local data: orgs Northwind Studio (120 clients, 640 invoices) and Bluebird Agency (45 clients, 210 invoices). API tests use their own Testcontainers database, so seeding does not affect them.
Jordan planned a long-weekend hike near Tobermory (Bruce Peninsula) right after 2026-10-02.
Jordan prefers shorter, tighter replies from the assistant (asked on 2026-10-05: 'you're being kinda long-winded, tighten it up').

tsx ^4.20.3 was added to packages/cli devDependencies so scripts (gen:completions, check:size) run directly from .ts without building; package.json was edited by hand and the pnpm lockfile was not yet updated (no install run), so run pnpm install before committing.

deps-bot's @types/node 20.14.10 -> 20.16.5 bump (#493) breaks the packages/cli typecheck with 7 errors, because src/http.ts imports Response from 'undici' while globals come from @types/node and the DOM lib. Proposed fix, not yet applied (Jordan said 'later'): drop the undici type import, use global types and remove "DOM" from the CLI tsconfig lib.

Cron jobs in the acme-platform worker are BullMQ repeatable jobs defined in services/worker/src/schedules.ts via upsertJobScheduler (no system cron or k8s CronJob). nightly-digest runs at 07:00 America/Toronto (moved from 06:00 on 2026-10-05); billing-sync every 15 min; purge-soft-deleted Sundays 03:30 UTC.

Jordan wants to add the k6 load test suite (about 40 min, hits staging) as a GitHub Actions CI job. The existing ci.yml has a single `check` job with timeout-minutes: 20 on every PR/push, so k6 would need its own job with a longer timeout, ideally workflow_dispatch or scheduled. No known team rule; .github/ is platform-owned, so check with Priya first.
